description: Active Atlantic tropical systems and the National Hurricane Center's 7-day outlook, as 787daily's hurricane hub judges them: each storm's strength, position, movement and distance from San Juan, and whether it is of concern for Puerto Rico (a tropical alert for the island, or not moving away and within 1,500 miles) or why not; each outlook area's 48-hour and 7-day formation chance. read=false means NHC did not answer, never an all-clear. Cite 787daily.com/hurricane/ and the National Hurricane Center.
name: get_tropical_status
